chronology: Protocol documented retrospectively after first execution; not preregistered or held-out neural learning evidence.
goal: Exact spacing, nesting of dyadic scalar prefixes, persistence through four nonlinear Mirror stages, and binary64 conversion control
single_scalar: s_p = floor(s_star*2^p)/2^p, s_star exact seeded 2048-bit fraction; no learned roles or separate scale
mirror_program: 4 residual repeats of Q^-1 tanh(Qz+fixed_bias), with fixed phase frequencies 7,10,13,16
success_condition: Dyadic prefix exactness for all precisions and finite nonzero Mirror output response
failure_condition: Any erroneous dyadic spacing or nonmatching prefix; no capacity conclusion
